japanese-kana.swsh: おちゃかいを　ひらいて ばにいる　ポケモンが　それぞれ もっている　きのみを　たべる。

french.swsh: Le lanceur invite tous les Pokémon sur le terrain à prendre le goûter autour d’une tasse de thé. Ceux qui tiennent une Baie la mangent.

german.swsh: Der Anwender lädt alle am Kampf beteiligten Pokémon zu einem Teekränzchen ein, woraufhin diese die Beeren essen, die sie bei sich tragen.

italian.swsh: Chi la usa invita tutti i Pokémon in campo a prendere il tè. Quelli che hanno con sé una bacca la mangiano.

english.swsh: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.
english.la: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.
english.sv: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon currently in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.

simplified-chinese.swsh: 举办一场茶会， 场上的所有宝可梦都会 吃掉自己携带的树果。

effect.full: All Pokemon on the field consume their held berries. This effect is not prevented by Substitute, Embargo, Magic Room, Klutz, or Unnerve. Fails if no active Pokemon is holding a berry.
effect.shortEffect: All Pokemon on the field consume their held berries.
